datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.source: Goodwin et al. 2014 (Duke, Clin Neurol Neurosurg, DOI 10.1016/j.clineuro.2014.09.015)
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.title: Risk factors for failed transverse sinus stenting in pseudotumor cerebri patients
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.study_design: Retrospective case-control: 15 VSS successes vs 3 VSS failures (required shunt)
longitudinal_outcome_available: need for shunt placement after stenting (binary: success vs failure)
phenotype_labels_available: PARTIAL — binary success/failure, NOT the canonical R2-C1/C2/C3/C4/C5 ontology. 'Failure' = needed shunt = likely R2-C1 (renewed ICP failure) but not classified per the frozen ontology.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.key_finding: Pre-stent OP 50 cmH2O (failures) vs 37 cmH2O (successes), p<0.05. Younger age (30 vs 40.7) and higher BMI (36.6 vs 33.3) showed non-significant trends.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.public_accessibility: Abstract publicly accessible via Duke Scholars. Full text paywalled. Per-patient data NOT in public supplement.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.fits_canonical_ontology: PARTIAL — outcome is binary success/failure, not the 6-category ontology. Could be re-classified as R2-C1 (failure=shunt=ICP failure) vs no-phenotype (success).
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.predictor_test_possible: YES for R2-C1 (baseline OP predicts shunt need). NO for R2-C3 (no R2-C3 cases identifiable in this cohort — failure was defined as 'needed shunt' which is R2-C1, not R2-C3).
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.value_to_predictor_discovery: HIGH — first dataset showing baseline OP predicts VSS failure phenotype (R2-C1). But n=18 is very small and only 3 failures.

datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.source: PMC12929161 (venous manometry diagnostic accuracy study, n=84)
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.title: Diagnostic accuracy of venous manometry to predict elevated intracranial pressure
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.study_design: Retrospective: patients with venous sinus stenosis who underwent catheter venography with venous pressure recording AND fluoroscopy-guided LP with CSF-OP measurement in the same session.
longitudinal_outcome_available: NO — this is a CROSS-SECTIONAL diagnostic study, not longitudinal. It predicts ICP at baseline, not post-VSS phenotype.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.key_finding: TSG ≥6 mmHg → sensitivity 0.86, specificity 0.80 for elevated ICP (CSF-OP ≥20 cmH2O). SSS pressure ≥15 mmHg → sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.68. Combined AUC 0.94.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.public_accessibility: Open access via PMC. Data availability statement: 'included in the article/supplementary material, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding authors.'
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.fits_canonical_ontology: NO — no post-VSS outcome. Cannot classify any R2-C phenotype.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.predictor_test_possible: NO for R2-C3 (no outcome data). YES for DIAGNOSTIC question (can venous manometry predict ICP elevation at baseline? — answered: YES, AUC 0.94).
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.value_to_predictor_discovery: MODERATE — establishes that baseline venous manometry (TSG, SSS pressure) strongly predicts baseline ICP. This is a building block for the predictor pipeline, but does NOT directly test predictor vs post-VSS phenotype. Could be combined with a longitudinal cohort to create the full predictor → phenotype test.

datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.title: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension: Prognostic Factors and Multidisciplinary Management
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.study_design: Retrospective single-center, 2001-2016. 13 patients with poor outcome after 6 months underwent unilateral TSS stenting.
longitudinal_outcome_available: visual outcome at 6 months (poor vs good)
phenotype_labels_available: PARTIAL — visual outcome (poor/good), NOT the canonical R2-C ontology.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.key_finding: Weight gain ≥5% since diagnosis → poor visual outcome (p<0.001). Bilateral TSS → poor outcome (OR 5.2, 95% CI 1.24-24.9, p=0.024). BMI at diagnosis NOT predictive.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.public_accessibility: Open access via PMC. Per-patient data NOT in public supplement.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.fits_canonical_ontology: PARTIAL — visual outcome could map to R2-C4 (visual failure despite controlled pressure) if ICP was controlled, but ICP status is not reported per-patient.
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.predictor_test_possible: YES for R2-C4-adjacent (weight gain predicts poor visual outcome). NO for R2-C3 (no headache + ICP + papilledema + restenosis joint data).
datasets_with_predictor_structure_found.value_to_predictor_discovery: MODERATE — establishes weight gain as predictor of poor IIH outcome. But only 13 patients had VSS stenting; the rest were managed medically. The predictor (weight gain) is tested against medical-management outcome, not VSS-specific outcome.

predictor_summary_after_search.key_finding: NO single open dataset contains [baseline predictors + longitudinal post-VSS outcome + canonical phenotype labels + public access]. The closest is Goodwin 2014 (predictor + binary failure outcome, n=18, no canonical phenotype labels). The predictor discovery pivot is REAL but UNTESTABLE for R2-C3 at zero cost — same epistemic boundary as R2-C3 existence.
what_WAS_found: Baseline OP predicts VSS failure (Goodwin 2014, n=18, OP 50 vs 37 cmH2O, p<0.05) — but 'failure' = needed shunt = R2-C1, not R2-C3.
TSG and SSS pressure strongly predict baseline ICP elevation (PMC12929161, n=84, AUC 0.94) — diagnostic, not predictive of post-VSS phenotype.
Weight gain ≥5% predicts poor visual outcome in IIH (PMC5572623, n=79, p<0.001) — medical management cohort, not VSS-specific.
what_WAS_NOT_found: No dataset with baseline predictors + post-VSS R2-C3 phenotype labels.
No dataset with headache phenotype (ICHD-3) + VSS outcome.
No dataset with CGRP biomarker + VSS outcome.
No dataset with early post-VSS ICP trajectory + long-term phenotype.
No dataset with multi-site venous pressure distribution + post-VSS phenotype.

predictor_hypotheses_generated.statement: Pre-VSS opening pressure >40 cmH2O predicts R2-C1 (renewed ICP failure requiring shunt) after VSS.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.evidence_support: Goodwin 2014 (n=18): failures had mean OP 50 cmH2O vs successes 37 cmH2O (p<0.05). Threshold appears to be ~40-45 cmH2O.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.testable_with_open_data: PARTIAL — Goodwin 2014 has the data but n=18 (3 failures). D'Amato 2025 has per-patient OP but 0 R2-C1 cases (the 1 R2-C1 case had OP 40, borderline).
predictor_hypotheses_generated.classification: EXPLORATORY — supported by 1 small study. Needs replication in a larger cohort.

predictor_hypotheses_generated.statement: Trans-stenotic gradient (TSG) ≥6 mmHg predicts elevated ICP (CSF-OP ≥20 cmH2O) at baseline.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.evidence_support: PMC12929161 (n=84): TSG ≥6 mmHg → sensitivity 0.86, specificity 0.80. Combined with SSS ≥15 mmHg → AUC 0.94.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.testable_with_open_data: YES — PMC12929161 is open access and provides the full ROC analysis.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.classification: STRONG for diagnostic question. Does NOT address post-VSS phenotype prediction.

predictor_hypotheses_generated.statement: Weight gain ≥5% after IIH diagnosis predicts poor visual outcome at 6 months.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.evidence_support: PMC5572623 (n=79): weight gain ≥5% → poor visual outcome (p<0.001).
predictor_hypotheses_generated.classification: STRONG for medical-management cohort. Does NOT address VSS-specific outcome.

predictor_hypotheses_generated.statement: Lower baseline venous pressure gradient predicts R2-C3 phenotype (headache despite ICP normalization).
predictor_hypotheses_generated.evidence_support: INDIRECT — Ahmed 2011 (mean gradient 20 mmHg) had 5.8% R2-C3; Midtlien 2025 (median 14 mmHg) had 57% group-level recurrence. But this is cross-cohort comparison, not within-cohort. Per Round 56d directive, this comparison is RETRACTED as it compares non-equivalent endpoints.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.testable_with_open_data: NO — no cohort has both per-patient gradient AND per-patient R2-C3 classification.
predictor_hypotheses_generated.classification: UNKNOWN — cannot be tested at zero cost.

verdict.strongest_predictor_hypothesis: PH-2 (TSG predicts baseline ICP, AUC 0.94) — but this is diagnostic, not predictive of post-VSS phenotype.
verdict.strongest_post_VSS_predictor_hypothesis: PH-1 (high baseline OP predicts R2-C1/shunt need) — supported by Goodwin 2014 (n=18, p<0.05) but small sample.
verdict.R2_C3_specific_predictor_hypothesis: PH-4 (low baseline gradient predicts R2-C3) — UNKNOWN, cannot be tested at zero cost.
verdict.epistemic_boundary: The predictor discovery pivot has reached the same epistemic boundary as R2-C3 existence: REAL question, UNTESTABLE at zero cost with current open data. The canonical phenotype ontology is FROZEN and ready for use when a suitable dataset becomes available.
verdict.mechanism_generation: BLOCKED — no change. Predictor hypotheses are NOT mechanisms. They are candidate decision boundaries that would need to be validated before any mechanism work begins.
